name: INITE AI Visibility
description: Four endpoints a third party may call. Two are public reads; two are JSON-RPC surfaces behind OAuth — MCP for a model holding tools, A2A for an agent handing another agent a task. Both are described by their own discovery documents, linked from `externalDocs`.
